component.name: M0Rf30 Easy Effects Presets
component.summary: A varied collection of presets to configure Easy Effects

description.p: Presets for Easy Effects: output presets (102) and microphone presets (2), plus the impulse responses and HRTF datasets they use. Bundled assets have mixed licenses; see THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md in the repository.

ul.li: Headphone virtualization with the Convolver (HeSuVi-derived, EFOtech MLV, synthetic crossfeed and binaural room, MIT KEMAR, ARI and IRCAM LISTEN HRTFs, and synthesized-renderer kernels: FLORA, ORCHARD, AQUILA, DELTA, LibreAtmos, LibreHolo, LibreSpatial, LibreDecibel, RICE)
Utility and effects (night listening, loudness leveling, mono sum, reference transparency, and others)
Microphone noise suppression and voice broadcast

description.p: FLORA Cinema and Music use dedicated true-stereo kernels in a convolver and limiter chain; the full-marker variants are removed.
Adds Reference Transparency: 18 Hz high-pass, ISO 226:2023 loudness compensation, true-peak-safe limiter.
Disables autogain and fixes limiter output gain across the FLORA presets to prevent level drift.
Adds the FLORA preset pack built on two self-authored true-stereo kernels.
Initial tagged release: 67 presets and 55 impulse-response/HRTF kernels.
